name: MF-NeRF Mixed-Feature Hash Encoding
definition: A memory efficient NeRF framework that shares scene features across consecutive grids by mixing multiple grids into a shared hash table, reducing memory usage and training time while preserving reconstruction quality.
summary: MF-NeRF Mixed-Feature Hash Encoding is a memory-efficient neural radiance field framework that reduces memory usage and training time by mixing multiple resolution grids into a single hash table to learn combined coarse and fine abstracted features.
